dimensions.assessment: Affects disabled veterans, veterans service organizations, VA employees, and individuals interacting with VA facilities and digital services.
dimensions.evidence: advisory committee on matters relating to accessibility of the Department for individuals with disabilities.

dimensions.assessment: Creates an advisory committee to evaluate accessibility barriers and extends existing home loan fee rates and pension provisions.
Involves travel expenses and administrative resources for committee members, alongside extensions of existing fee structures.
dimensions.evidence: A member of the Advisory Committee shall be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code to mandate a new advisory committee and restructure VA advisory bodies.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall establish an advisory committee on matters relating to accessibility of the Department for individuals with disabilities.

dimensions.assessment: The advisory committee is mandated to terminate seven years after enactment, while certain loan fee and pension provisions have specific extension dates.
dimensions.evidence: The Advisory Committee shall terminate on the date that is seven years after the date of the enactment

missing_information: Exact budgetary costs for supporting the new advisory committee are not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish a 15-member Veterans Advisory Committee on Equal Access after abolishing or consolidating inactive advisory committees, and extends certain VA home loan fee rates and pension limitations.
